evidence_units.interpretation: Survivor selection and missing comparable untreated/CuHis groups prevent a clean causal claim of neurological normalization. Treated animals retain significantly more stumbles than wild-type.

evidence_units.endpoint: Cuproenzyme activity, organ markers and histology.
evidence_units.denominator: Age/survival strata differ; some late CuHis samples have only two or three animals.
evidence_units.interpretation: Elevated ALT and beta-2-microglobulin deserve attention. A claimed adaptive/reversible explanation is not verified longitudinal reversal; normal histology or negative staining does not establish complete safety.

evidence_units.endpoint: FDA survival assessment from two single-arm clinical studies with external controls.
evidence_units.denominator: 66 treated participants and 17 untreated contemporary external controls overall.
evidence_units.interpretation: Different human comparator evidence; not randomized, not CuNC evidence and not proof of neurological equivalence.

positive_evidence: A defined formulation improves early survival against the study's copper-histidine comparator in a severe ATP7A-deficient mouse model.
Brain cuproenzyme activity and later behavioral observations support investigating a neurological contribution.
A named university/hospital patent family offers a plausible translation/partner route.
negative_or_limiting_evidence: A study endpoint at day 50 cannot establish 50-day median lifespan for a group with survivors at the boundary.
Later behavioral comparisons are subject to differential survival and are not a robust matched surviving-disease-control demonstration.
Residual coordination deficits remain; nonsignificance versus wild-type is not equivalence.
Reported biochemical safety abnormalities are not neutralized by qualitative histology or an untested reversibility explanation.
FDA-approved copper histidinate now supplies a survival-benefit baseline; untreated-only need cannot define the incremental product claim.
Early neonatal treatment does not establish treatment of later irreversible neurological damage.

rights_and_capture.observed: WO2022238656A1, published 2022-11-17, names University of Lorraine and CHU Nancy in the indexed record and describes copper nanocluster/Menkes uses. The WO indexed status is ceased while national family entries remain; this does not establish family abandonment. Current official national prosecution, title and available license are not verified.
rights_and_capture.capture_inference: This is an institutional formulation-development opportunity, not unowned generic copper. A reproducible manufacturing/product contribution and incremental advantage over approved therapy could retain value, but neither is established as an offered transaction.
unresolved: Exact candidate formulation and released product specification
Current territorial rights and license availability
Survival censoring and survivor-stratified functional evidence
Incremental neurological, delivery or safety benefit versus approved copper histidinate

records.financing_scope: Finite existing-data and product/rights audit first. Full nanomedicine manufacturing, chronic safety and pediatric clinical development would be a materially larger program than a small model-qualification tranche; no numerical budget is asserted.
records.cheapest_next_information_gate: Reconcile survival censoring, age/selection strata and the exact formulation-to-patent relationship, then state a testable incremental claim against current copper histidinate. Determine whether existing data distinguish brain-function or product benefit beyond systemic survival; stop if they only support the already-satisfied untreated comparison.
records.stopping_rule: Hold broad brain-restoration claims if surviving-control comparisons cannot distinguish treatment from survival selection. Re-scope to a narrower systemic or practical product benefit only if it remains clinically consequential against approved copper histidinate. Hold development if reliable formulation control or an obtainable value contribution remains undefined. A feasible neonatal-prevention window is acceptable and does not require adult reversal.
records.comparison_to_apr_blu: The existing-data survival/comparator audit is inexpensive in kind and consequential, but it is a different purchase from APR/BLU useful-function qualification. A chronic pediatric nanomedicine program has more manufacturing and comparator dependencies. No higher funded rank is justified by the large untreated-mouse effect alone; an actual narrow data/option package could still be worth comparing on equal terms.

record.name: Cyclo(His-Pro) for DMD
record.disposition: Partnered/sponsor program scout; not retained as a standalone new development asset.
record.useful_signal: Mouse grip/hanging function and preventive-cohort ex-vivo force improve; a later-start cohort is also reported.
record.limiting_evidence: No endurance or eccentric-injury protection and no CK improvement. Ex-vivo force evidence from the preventive cohort cannot simply be assigned to the later-start cohort; no human DMD functional result.
record.rights: NovMetaPharma funding and company-affiliated coauthors; WO2025127437A1 is assigned in the index to Novmetapharma and explicitly addresses muscle-function/disease use. No license offer or current enforceability determination established.
record.reason: A potentially useful competitor/partner rather than a generic untouched molecule; its mechanism and incremental DMD contribution do not presently beat the retained finite information gates.
record.future_trigger: A distinct obtainable partnership/product contribution or independent clinically relevant functional/exposure evidence.

record.name: GBT601 plus PT2399 for NDUFS4-related Leigh disease
record.disposition: Strong functional science; partnered/rights-complex reserve, not retained for an independent small next development tranche.
record.useful_signal: The paper reports late-treatment Ndufs4-knockout motor/survival benefit, including combination benefit after advanced disease. This is stronger timing evidence than the preventive FD-2/CuNC studies.
record.limiting_evidence: Systemic oxygen-affinity/HIF-2 physiology introduces a distinct translation and safety problem. The separate Friedreich model improved motor trajectories without lifespan or cardiac rescue. Voxelotor withdrawal is a related-class caution, not an exact GBT601-Leigh failure.
record.rights: Paper discloses MGH hypoxia-related patent interests and relevant author company equity; GBT601 belongs to an existing industry asset lineage. Current exact trial status, available rights and a combined-product offer were not established.
record.reason: Do not downgrade the functional signal to justify a preferred list. The existing candidate/combination and interdependent systemic physiology currently imply a larger partnered program than the chosen document-level asset gates.
record.future_trigger: An obtainable scoped collaboration or product contribution, exact current asset status, and an interpretable relevant-exposure safety/benefit package.
record.lineage: Preprint and PNAS paper are the same study lineage, not two replications. The bounded search did not substantiate a claim that GBT601 is discontinued.

record.name: Nifuroxazide for CHCHD10-S59L disease
record.useful_signal: Patient fibroblast and patient-derived motor-neuron mitochondrial morphology/motility and stress-associated survival observations.
record.limiting_evidence: No organism motor function or mature neuromuscular output in the retrieved study. MICOS-complex stability was not restored. MIC13/QIL1-cell findings are narrower network readouts, not demonstrated cross-disease cristae rescue.
record.rights: The primary paper reports PCT/EP2022/083829 filed 2022-11-30. Generic drug access and a no-conflict declaration do not establish an unencumbered neurological product. Relevant exposure was not verified.
record.reason: Subcellular/cell-survival restoration has a less direct useful-function bridge than retained mammalian functional assets, with exposure and product capture still unresolved.
record.future_trigger: Independent organism or patient-derived mature functional benefit at relevant exposure plus an obtainable differentiated contribution.
